verdicts.label: A
verdicts.evidence: The operation $f(n) = \lfloor n/10 \rfloor + 3(n \pmod{10})$ satisfies $f(n) \equiv 3n \pmod{29}$. For $n_0 = 260^{135}$, we have $n_0 \equiv (-1)^{135} \equiv -1 \pmod{29}$. Thus $n_{2025} \equiv 3^{2025} \cdot (-1) \equiv -(3^{28})^{72} \cdot 3^9 \equiv -3^9 \equiv -21 \equiv 8 \pmod{29}$. The only value in the attractor set $\{1, \dots, 29\}$ that satisfies this is 8, not 29.
